description: Rules more than one document must agree on. Not a bundle document: no package lists it, so no model reads it. A rule with a single home stays prose in that document.

rules.statement: Every place the answer names appears in the backend facts, spelled exactly as the facts spell it.
rules.basis: A name is an identifier. 광복궁 for 경복궁 points at a place that does not exist, and a reader who searches for it finds nothing.

homes.mustContain: alter a place name by even one character
Inventing an attraction the backend did not return

rules.statement: The answer states the visit order the backend returned and no other.
rules.basis: Ranking and ordering belong to the consuming service's backend. See decisions/keep-llm-out-of-ranking.md.

homes.mustContain: change visit order
Reordering course items

rules.statement: The answer never says the crowded destination was moved to a later position.
rules.basis: CourseRoutePolicy.bestOrder returns listOf(originId) + best, so the original destination is always the first visit and is never deferred.

homes.mustContain: pushed to a later slot
say the crowded destination was moved later
does not say the crowded destination was moved to a later position

rules.statement: The answer gives no time-of-day, day-of-week, or hourly reason for crowding or for a visit time.
rules.basis: Every congestion fact covers a whole date and nothing finer; a visit time is departure plus travel time. The 2026-08-03 spike settled that the public congestion API carries a date and no time field.

homes.mustContain: say that crowding depends on the hour
Giving a time-of-day reason for a visit time
give a time-of-day reason for a visit time
does not give a time-of-day reason

rules.statement: The answer asserts no weather condition.
rules.basis: No consumer service supplies a weather fact. records/weather/rules.json and concepts/weather-aware-travel-recommendation.md are evidence without a producer.

homes.mustContain: claim any weather condition
Asserting a weather condition
assert a weather condition
does not claim a weather condition

rules.statement: Every path in citations is one of the separator-line paths of the assembled bundle, and the array is never empty.
rules.basis: A source that cannot be verified is treated exactly like an invented one, so an answer whose citations cannot be resolved is discarded before it reaches anyone.

homes.mustContain: copied **exactly**, including its directory and its file extension
Every path the explanation cites exists in the assembled bundle
so a citation can be checked against the bundle

rules.statement: When a place has no forecast coverage the answer says so and supplies no grade, percentile, concentration, or better-date list.
rules.basis: hasCongestionData false is HTTP 200 with success true: missing coverage is a product state, not a failure, and reaching for a number here is the exact failure this wiki exists to prevent.

homes.mustContain: invent a diagnosis when there is none
inventing one is the exact failure
there is no grade, percentile, or better-date list

rules.statement: The answer never names the system that produced it, and never argues about what the model did or did not do.
rules.basis: The traveller is reading about their day. Measured on live courses: two of three explanations ended in a spiral of denials, and one named the backend by a mangled transliteration of its own name.

homes.mustContain: name the system that produced any of this

homes.mustNotContain: State that the service backend selected
avoid claiming that the LLM selected or ordered anything
